subject: POC MAP: credit amendment, ramp milestones, and conversion pricing
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: julia@brightoak.com, nate.jackson@brightoak.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — MAP draft and initial credits

Hi Julia / Nate —

Great to have BrightOak on the POC. Per our call today I'm attaching a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties target milestones to a pilot credits pool and conversion guidance so we have a clear path to production if the evaluation hits the success criteria. High-level summary: 

- Pilot window: 6 weeks (target start 2026-11-15)
- Pilot credits: 300k token-equivalent credits (applied to hosted inference) + 1 week free trial extension if needed
- Success milestone A (week 2): ML accuracy > 87% on curated eval set -> unlock 50% of credits for integration testing
- Success milestone B (week 4): latency benchmarks (p95 < 450ms) and baseline traffic simulation -> unlock remaining credits
- Conversion guidance: list price + 15% introductory discount for first 3 months if BrightOak commits to >= 250k inference units/month within 6 months of conversion

Requested next steps: please review the attached MAP (BrightOak_MAP_v2.pdf) and the POC SOW (POC_SOW.xlsx). If the credit amount or discount needs adjustment, flag it here and I’ll loop in our pricing lead.

I'll also bring Priyom on the technical kickoff to lock down evaluation datasets and perf test harness.

Thanks — talk soon,

— Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: BrightOak_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP, 3 pages), POC_SOW.xlsx (SOW, 8 rows)
From: julia@brightoak.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: nate.jackson@brightoak.com, procurement@brightoak.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — MAP draft and initial credits

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A few asks from our side after reviewing with ML and procurement: 

1) Pilot credits: can we increase to 450k token-equivalent? We want to include an extra week of real traffic replay which will bump consumption.
2) Conversion discount: 15% is a good start, but procurement is pushing for a 20% committed discount if we sign within 45 days post-POC and commit to the 250k/mo ramp. Can Redwood offer a staggered discount (20% first 2 months, then 15% for months 3-6)?
3) We will likely need a 2-week trial extension beyond the pilot window if integration takes longer.

If we can get closer on credits and the short-term discount structure, procurement is willing to fast-track signature.

Cheers,
Julia Park
Director of Data & AI | BrightOak Health
julia@brightoak.com
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — MAP draft and initial credits (internal)

Team —

Saw BrightOak's ask. I'm comfortable approving the credit increase to 450k token-equivalent for the POC on the condition we: 
- Convert the MAP to include a clear evaluation checklist (Prio: eval set + perf harness) and acceptance sign-off by BrightOak's ML lead
- Include a measurable ramp commitment clause that triggers the short-term discount caps

On discounts: we can approve a promotional structure of 20% for months 1-2 post-conversion, stepping to 15% for months 3-6, provided BrightOak signs within 45 days of POC acceptance and commits contractually to the 250k/mo target (we'll add an optional clawback if the ramp isn't met within 6 months).

Action for Lauren / Aditya: update the MAP and SOW with the credit bump, discount cadence, and the optional clawback language; keep the total upfront promotional exposure capped to the equivalent of 2.5 months at the higher discount. Priyom — confirm the evaluation checklist verbiage and perf tests.

— Vivek
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: julia@brightoak.com, nate.jackson@brightoak.com
Cc: procurement@brightoak.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — MAP draft and initial credits

Hi Julia / Nate —

Thanks — we've updated the MAP and SOW per the approvals. Summary of agreed changes: 

- Pilot credits: increased to 450k token-equivalent (applies to hosted inference during POC)
- Trial extension: up to 2 additional weeks available if integration extends beyond the 6-week window (must be requested before week 5)
- Conversion discount: promotional cadence agreed: 20% off list for months 1-2 post-conversion, 15% for months 3-6, conditional on a contractual commit to 250k inference units/month within 45 days of POC acceptance. Clawback clause added if ramp not met within 6 months (pro-rated).
- Acceptance criteria: included a short checklist (accuracy threshold, latency target, and basic stability under replay) — Priyom will run the perf harness and confirm test plan by 2026-11-29.

Next steps for BrightOak: 
1) Review attached BrightOak_MAP_v2.pdf and POC_SOW.xlsx with procurement; if OK please reply with signed acceptance or sign via the DocuSign link below.
2) Tech kickoff: Priyom will send a calendar invite for next Tue to set datasets and perf tests.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/0Z2Q7-example
Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/abcd-Map-BrightOak-v2

Best,
